document: Transport energy and environment: data tables (ENV)
rows: Transport energy and environment: data tables (ENV)
Fuel consumption and emissions for different transport modes
Fuel consumption, greenhouse gases, pollutants/noise and journey emissions
Coverage periods differ by table according to the latest available source data
ENV0102: UK transport-mode and energy-source consumption, 1998 to 2024, ODS 15.3 KB
ENV0201: UK greenhouse gas emissions by transport mode, 1990 to 2024, ODS 36.3 KB
ENV0202: UK carbon dioxide emissions by transport mode, 1990 to 2024, ODS 36.3 KB
ENV0701 is paused as an Official Statistic in Development during methodology and quality review
quality_note: Official GOV.UK dataset-page metadata only. Linked ODS values were not ingested or bound to parcels.
